checks.claim: truth yields fixed visual points for every future render matrix
checks.falsifier: a venue with no gates, no district anchors, and no coasters
checks.soWhat: without fixed points, visual drift is compared at one convenient screenshot

checks.claim: the ground under this venue comes from a named DEM, or is declared flat
checks.falsifier: a heightfield appears with no source recorded
checks.soWhat: a fabricated heightfield looks convincing and is wrong everywhere

checks.claim: the hillshade covers exactly the venue truth already published
checks.falsifier: the overlay is placed on a rectangle truth did not publish
checks.soWhat: an overlay on the wrong rectangle shades the wrong ground

checks.claim: a radar surface model is labelled as one, not passed off as ground
checks.falsifier: a DSM is reported as resolving bare ground
checks.soWhat: at 30m over a park one sample blends canopy, roof and ride structure

checks.claim: base.pmtiles builds and fits the 15 MB pack budget, or the tiler is a recorded gap
checks.evidence: tippecanoe not installed — GeoJSON + tippecanoe.sh recipe written; run it to build base.pmtiles
checks.falsifier: tippecanoe runs and the archive is broken or exceeds the download budget
checks.soWhat: the display pack rides the venue download; an oversized or broken archive blocks it, and a missing tiler leaves the vector tier unbuilt

checks.claim: kit "watercolor-quest" has a committed reference profile
checks.falsifier: a kit on disk with no profile under data/display/references/
checks.soWhat: no contract, no certification — the look would drift unmeasured

checks.claim: every sampled terrain class stays inside its profile color family
checks.evidence: grass ΔE 0.3/14, wood ΔE 0/14, water ΔE 0/14, lot ΔE 0/14, road ΔE 0/12, service ΔE 0/12, outside ΔE 0/14
checks.falsifier: worst class grass beyond tolerance on a rerun
checks.soWhat: palette drift is the first way a design language stops matching its reference

checks.claim: every terrain class the venue truth implies (map.grass, map.parking, map.water, …) survives to the sampled render
checks.evidence: truth implies grass, lot, road, service, water, wood; all present
checks.falsifier: a terrain class present in truth geometry vanishing from the composited render (e.g. a boundary-unaware paint order painting over it)
checks.soWhat: a bake that silently drops a class can certify clean while shipping an empty or wrong-looking world

checks.claim: world anchors project onto truth through the pack bounds (≤ 0.05 cells), and every painted feature stays inside the 1.211 m alignment budget (no band — 3 px of this bake, pre-ADR-0021)
checks.evidence: 64 truth anchor(s) sampled, worst offset 0 cells = 0.002 m (projection tolerance 0.05 cells); declared stroke displacement 2 px = 0.808 m; alignment budget 1.211 m from no band — 3 px of this bake, pre-ADR-0021, at 6.46 m a cell and 0.404 m a baked pixel
checks.falsifier: a model whose badge positions no longer derive from truth through its own bounds, or a band drawing a feature further from truth than its ground-metre budget allows
checks.soWhat: a world image that drifts from truth moves every Place a guest stands next to — at the close band a metre of drift is seven pixels of blue route crossing painted lawn

checks.claim: road centerline ink separates from paper (ΔE ≥ 20)
checks.evidence: best roadline sample vs paper ΔE 54.6
checks.falsifier: linework styles whose ink fades into the paper
checks.soWhat: near-monochrome styles carry hierarchy in ink, not fill

checks.claim: water reads as water (ΔE ≥ 12 vs vegetation and ground)
checks.evidence: water vs grass ΔE 31.2, vs ground ΔE —
checks.falsifier: a pool that reads as lawn
checks.soWhat: the kit brief’s own promise, now enforced

checks.claim: the world outside the venue separates from the park floor (ΔE ≥ 6)
checks.falsifier: a bake where the park has no edge
checks.soWhat: the boundary is the first thing the reference maps establish

checks.claim: buildings paint in the profile's interior treatment
checks.falsifier: a kit whose buildings vanish into terrain
checks.soWhat: structures are the landmarks navigation hangs on

checks.claim: ride tracks separate from the terrain under them (fill or casing, ΔE ≥ 10)
checks.falsifier: a flume whose fill AND casing both dissolve into the lawn
checks.soWhat: rides are why the map exists

checks.claim: every badge disc samples badge ink, never the terrain under it
checks.falsifier: a badge painted under a later layer (ADR-0012 rule: annotation pass last)
checks.soWhat: POI pins must survive every style

checks.claim: one badge per POI position
checks.falsifier: duplicate pins stacked on one POI
checks.soWhat: ADR-0012 declutter rule, model-side

checks.claim: nothing readable is baked into the band — every painted badge kind resolves to an icon glyph, never a letter
checks.evidence: 6 painted badge kind(s) resolve to icon glyphs: food→parkbound-badge-food, gate→parkbound-badge-gate, restroom→parkbound-badge-restroom, service→parkbound-badge-service, shop→parkbound-badge-shop, show→parkbound-badge-show
checks.falsifier: a painter falling back to a character when a badge kind has no icon, or a POI badge kind shipped with no glyph art
checks.soWhat: a baked word cannot be read aloud, cannot change language, cannot dodge a party dot, and cannot survive a rename without re-baking every Skin

checks.claim: a fresh render of the same model samples byte-identical pixels
checks.falsifier: any clock or RNG sneaking into the compositor
checks.soWhat: determinism is the bake’s core guarantee

checks.claim: sibling kits of this venue sample distinct pixels
checks.evidence: no sibling kits in this invocation — nothing to compare
checks.falsifier: two kits that only differ in name
checks.soWhat: the factory exists to make different-looking maps

checks.claim: every baked kit passes its reference-profile style contract
checks.falsifier: a kit whose style-cert.json reports certified:false, or no bakes at all
checks.soWhat: an uncertified look must not ride the venue download

checks.claim: every bound material’s compiled textures resolve on disk (pin-verified), or the gap is recorded
checks.evidence: 6/9 bound materials compiled; recorded gaps: water--calm (no fetchable source (material-maker://graphs/water-calm) — authored graphs render flat until exported by hand), water--pool (no fetchable source (material-maker://graphs/water-pool) — authored graphs render flat until exported by hand), fiberglass--flume (no fetchable source (material-maker://graphs/fiberglass-flume) — authored graphs render flat until exported by hand)
checks.falsifier: a ledger row claiming compiled bytes that are missing or sha-drifted
checks.soWhat: a bake told to tile a texture that is not there paints the authored flat and silently stops matching its certified look

checks.claim: every bound surface resolves to a ledger material
checks.falsifier: a binding names a material absent from data/display/materials.json
checks.soWhat: an unresolved binding renders as a hole in the ground on every phone

checks.claim: every shipped material carries an allowed license with provenance
checks.falsifier: a ledger row carries a license outside the allowed set
checks.soWhat: license before embed — an AGPL texture in the bundle is a shipping bug

checks.claim: every coordinate in the spec is one truth already published — skins restyle, never reposition
checks.evidence: every coordinate in the spec matches a published bound
checks.falsifier: a spec carries any position value the truth bounds do not already contain
checks.soWhat: a display file that can move a Place breaks the truth/display split

checks.claim: every styled land exists in truth geometry
checks.falsifier: a land tone names a district the map does not have
checks.soWhat: styling a district that does not exist means a tint silently never draws

checks.claim: spec ≤ 64 KB and materials ≤ 1024px
checks.falsifier: a spec or bound material exceeds the phone budget
checks.soWhat: display packs ride the venue download budget; an oversized pack blocks the gate download
